purpose: First real-data capture pilot. Validate physical SKU workflow, annotation ergonomics and real-data validator before collecting R02-R10.

groups.instruction: Full frontal shelf view. All eight SKU identities clearly visible. Neutral camera height.
Front view with controlled distance variation. Alternate slightly closer and farther positions.
Small lateral camera shifts while remaining broadly frontal. Do not turn this into an oblique-session condition.
Reset and slightly rearrange product positions. Preserve all eight semantic SKU identities.
Mild natural occlusion and shelf variation. Keep every SKU class represented in the group.
